target.title: fix(tui): suppress unhandled rejection from async agent event handler
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The TUI embedded backend onAgentEvent callback calls `void this.handleAgentEvent(evt)` without `.catch()`. The handler is async with no internal try/catch — if it rejects, the unhandled promise rejection crashes the TUI process.

## Why This Change Was Made

Add `.catch(() => {})` to suppress the unhandled rejection.

## User Impact

TUI no longer crashes on unexpected agent event handler rejections.

## Evidence

**Before**: `void this.handleAgentEvent(evt)` — async handler without catch → unhandled rejection → crash

**After**: `void this.handleAgentEvent(evt).catch(() => {})` — rejection suppressed

## Risk

Low. One `.catch(() => {})` addition.
